_comment: How to play's pages (M48i, SPEC.md §11 Cards; src/help.js): a tab each, at most three lines, and a small board that plays one thing over and over with the game's own counters. TONIGHT has no scene: its lines are tonight's mission's, written by main.js. A line may quote a rule by its path in rules.json, {charges.fuseTurns}, and one given as { text, if } or { text, unless } is said only where that rule is set, or not. A scene's rows are read as a map's (data/map.json), in its `legend`, with a mission's own `ground` put over it so a scene is printed in tonight's country (the desert's sand and dunes cost as the fields and woods do); a hex is [column, row], and an even row's first and an odd row's last hex are half off the edge and not shown. `sight` is what the garrison sees: the danger wash's red. The steps, in order: men, enemies (who stands where, by role and by type: tonight's own counters are put on them), select (a man, or null), hover (his way, hex by hex, from beside him), walk (along it, a hex a frame), key ({ text, by }: a key pressed, in the pen beside him), charge (set by that man), suppress and kill ({ by, enemy }), note ({ at, text }), face ({ enemy, facing }), endTurn (true, or untilBlast to turn until the last charge goes off), clearBlast; and ms, how long the step's picture stays. A walk's AP and a charge's fuse are the rules' own; a test holds every walk to ground a man can cross.

lines: Click a man, or press 1–6: The blue is how far he can go this turn. Hover a hex: The line is his way there, each step shows the AP spent by then.
Click to go. Cover is slow going: 2 AP a hex. SPACE ends the turn: the garrison moves, and every man's AP comes back.
Hover anything on the board to ask what it is. KEYBOARD lists every key.
Hover before he moves: red ground gets him seen on the way; blue is safe. Cover blocks sight: woods, hedges, dunes, walls and buildings.
Seen is a warning (the red !). Next turn, get him out of sight, or he is fired on at the end of the turn.
Hide [H] makes a man harder to see, and ends his turn.
The red dashed hexes are charge points. Stand a man with a charge (an orange dot) on one and press C.

lines.text: The fuse burns {charges.fuseTurns} turns, counted down on the watch beside it. Get him clear before it blows.
Every charge takes a timer: after pressing C, pick a time pencil from the tin. Get clear before it blows.

lines: A gunner can Suppress [S] an enemy he can see: its head goes down, and it will not see, fire or move until its next go. Loud: the alert goes up.
Then, that turn or the next, a gunner can Kill [K] it with one silenced shot: quieter, but it leaves a body.

lines.text: Anyone can Knife [N] an enemy beside him that is looking the other way: silent, but it takes his whole turn.
Anyone can Knife [N] an enemy beside him that is looking the other way. It takes his whole turn, and here it is heard {noise.knife} hexes off.

lines: When the job is done move the men onto the EXFIL. A man who reaches it is out, off the board.
Get at least {mission.minimumOut} out before dawn, or the mission fails.
